**graph, git:** `rename` verifies every file before writing any, so a stale later file no longer leaves earlier files rewritten, and the daemon drops its graph whatever the outcome. `what-changed` reads diff paths exactly (`b/b/x.rs`, non-ASCII names and `diff.noprefix` repos) and reports a git failure inside a repository instead of risk `LOW`. The build now edits `.git/info/exclude` under the build lock and replaces it atomically.
